title: R-side Scenario 1 preview fidelity registry
note: This registry describes the current synthetic OpenATCA preview. A referenced FAA task or standard is not evidence of current ERAM/STARS interface parity.

entries.label: R-side prototype banner
entries.availability: Visible · OpenATCA difference
entries.description: The R-side role is documented in an FAA human-factors evaluation. This banner, role workflow and screen arrangement are OpenATCA content, not an ERAM specification.

entries.label: Synthetic surveillance picture
entries.availability: Visible · OpenATCA drawing
entries.description: Shows a deterministic synthetic traffic scenario through the OpenATCA PVD-style drawing core. This is not a verified ERAM map, symbol set, or surveillance presentation.

sources.label: JO 7110.65BB · radar identification and tracking procedures

entries.label: Tracking target symbol
entries.availability: Visible · OpenATCA difference
entries.description: Square outline and centre dot are OpenATCA symbols. No public source in the fidelity reference establishes this ERAM symbol shape.

entries.label: Coasting marker and CST tag
entries.availability: Visible when synthetic track coasts · OpenATCA difference
entries.description: The X marker and CST text are OpenATCA encodings, not claimed ERAM status symbology.

entries.label: Uncertainty marker, radius and UNC/R95? tags
entries.availability: Visible for synthetic uncertainty states · OpenATCA difference
entries.description: Diamond, radius circle, and tags describe OpenATCA tracker output. They do not claim the installed ERAM uncertainty display.

entries.label: Reacquisition ring and REACQ tag
entries.availability: Visible for synthetic reacquisition states · OpenATCA difference
entries.description: The ring and tag are OpenATCA encodings; no current ERAM display source is asserted.

entries.label: Callsign conflict marker and CS? tag
entries.availability: Visible for synthetic identity ambiguity · OpenATCA difference
entries.description: Showing an address instead of choosing between two callsigns is OpenATCA behavior. ERAM responsibility for correct identity is relevant context, not evidence for this encoding.

entries.label: Synthetic callsign or hexadecimal address
entries.availability: Visible · synthetic values
entries.description: All displayed identities are generated for the demo. The report does not contain real aircraft identifiers, and the selected target is not an ERAM identity-entry workflow.

entries.label: Altitude label
entries.availability: Visible · OpenATCA field format
entries.description: Altitude is shown in hundreds of feet as an OpenATCA label. No ERAM block field order, abbreviations, arrows, or assigned-state encoding is claimed.

sources.label: JO 7110.65BB · data blocks and altitude status

entries.label: Ground-speed label
entries.availability: Visible · OpenATCA field format
entries.description: Ground speed is drawn in an OpenATCA three-line data label. ERAM fourth-line format and local authorization are not represented.

sources.label: JO 7110.65BB · data block and fourth-line rules

entries.label: Three-line traffic label and state tags
entries.availability: Visible · OpenATCA difference
entries.description: The prototype label has three lines. FAA guidance requires a fourth line in the stated context, but public sources do not supply the local field layout. This preview does not implement that ERAM block format.

sources.label: JO 7110.65BB · data block and fourth-line rules
vice ERAM overview · community comparison only

entries.label: Pointer target selection and SELECT RAW/FLT label
entries.availability: Available · OpenATCA pointer interaction
entries.description: Nearest-target selection within the prototype hit radius and its selection labels are OpenATCA behavior. Current ERAM selector controls and exact state transitions are not established by the referenced legacy study.

sources.label: DOT/FAA/TC-TN06/04 · legacy FLID and selection study

entries.label: OpenATCA palette and alert color
entries.confidence: PRIMARY-FAA · palette policy, not installed palette evidence
entries.availability: Visible · OpenATCA palette
entries.description: FAA standards and policy provide color-use constraints. The prototype palette is not established as matching installed ERAM/STARS colors or field-by-field assignments.

entries.label: Fourth-line ERAM data block content
entries.availability: Not implemented · explicit difference
entries.description: This prototype uses a three-line label and does not show the required fourth-line content for the stated ERAM context. Do not infer a field or fill it with invented text.

entries.label: Live Conflict Alert status
entries.availability: Active · real OpenATCA CA
entries.description: The engine runs oa-ca at every5-second scan after reports at that timestamp. Its active pair count and running/degraded/unavailable state drive the status line. Preview adaptation:3NM/1000ft,60-second lookahead,5-second hysteresis,60tracks and1770pairs; these are explicit development values, not ERAM/STARS facility settings. Mode C Intruder is not configured.

entries.label: Minimum Safe Altitude Warning
entries.availability: Not configured · grey preview status
entries.description: Terrain/obstacle coverage and altimeter adaptation are not configured. Public Chicago MVA data alone is not an MSAW warning floor. The grey notice states this preview limit; it is not a failed running safety net.

entries.label: Facility sectors and frequencies
entries.availability: Not shown
entries.description: No real ZAU/C90 sector names, frequencies, or facility adaptation are displayed. The scenario uses synthetic traffic and public procedure geometry only.

entries.label: Engine-owned range and pan
entries.availability: Active · OpenATCA difference
entries.description: Initial KORD-centered range fits scenario entry positions with a ten percent margin. Focus the scope: minus increases range, equals decreases range, arrows pan ten percent of range, Home centers KORD. The range shown in the Rust frame is engine state. These preview keys are not asserted to be ERAM controls.

entries.label: Deterministic data-block placement and leader
entries.availability: Active · OpenATCA difference
entries.description: Engine-owned eight-position leader placement in fixed lexical callsign order; visible candidate with the fewest existing block intersections, then overlap area and target penalties; strict improvement preserves default ties. Outer-terminal overlaps are tested at0/5/15/30/60min; both-aircraft-inside5NM overlaps are reported separately.

entries.label: Approach-path and area-proximity preview limits
entries.availability: Not configured · grey preview status
entries.description: Approach-path monitoring and area proximity are not configured in this preview. These are grey configuration notices; real CA failures still appear as alerts.
